insights.headline: Gold slips below ₹1,22,000 on MCX as silver slides to ₹1,43,920 ahead of US core PCE
insights.summary: Spot gold held near $3,545 an ounce after Tuesday's 2% slide, with silver near $40.70 as it tests support close to $39.50. On MCX, December gold touched a morning low of ₹1,21,414 per 10 g and silver fell to ₹1,43,920 per kg, while the rupee strengthened to 92.62 against the dollar. Traders price a near-certain December Fed hike and now await US core PCE at 19:00 IST, the next test before the Fed's 9 December decision.
points: Spot gold held near $3,544.54 an ounce after falling more than 2% in the previous session.
Silver held near $40.70 and now tests support near $39.53, with the 200-week average at $39.90.
MCX December gold touched a morning low of ₹1,21,414 per 10 g; silver fell to ₹1,43,920 per kg.
The rupee rose 23 paise to 92.62 against the dollar on foreign inflows and lower crude.
Traders price a 96.4% chance of a December Fed hike; US core PCE is due today at 19:00 IST.

brief.headline: Gold slips to $3,545 as Fed hike bets firm
brief.summary: Spot gold $3,544.54 after a 2% slide, MCX gold Rs 1,22,505, as hawkish Fed signals firm up December hike bets.

bullets.text: Hawkish Fed signals and near-certain December hike bets weighed on bullion, while equity losses forced sales to raise cash.
MCX tracked the global slide, silver falling harder than gold, while a firm dollar kept pressure on rupee-priced bullion.
Watch today: US core PCE at 19:00 IST, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, ahead of its 9 December decision.

trending.title: Gold slips again ahead of US core PCE
trending.summary: MCX gold touched a morning low of ₹1,21,414 after Tuesday's 2% slide took spot gold to $3,544.54, as hawkish Fed signals firmed December hike bets and traders await today's PCE print at 19:00 IST.

trending.title: Silver tests major support near $40
trending.summary: Silver fell to $40.73, below its prior low, and now tests a support zone near $39.53, while MCX silver slid to ₹1,43,920 in morning trade.

trending.title: MCX tracks the global slide
trending.summary: December gold ended the evening session down 2.8% at Rs 1,22,505 and silver down as much as 6%, then slipped further in Wednesday morning trade on Fed hike bets and a firm dollar.

trending.title: Rupee strength softens the blow for Indian buyers
trending.summary: The rupee rose to 92.62 against the dollar, up over 1.6% in five sessions, on foreign inflows and lower crude; a stronger rupee makes dollar-priced gold cheaper in rupee terms.

trending.title: Silver's supply gap won't close soon
trending.summary: Mine output stays flat in 2026 despite a sixth straight annual deficit, as most silver comes as a byproduct of other metals' mines; weaker solar demand could even tip the market into surplus in 2027.

items.title: Gold, silver prices trade lower as Fed rate-hike expectations strengthen
items.summary: MCX gold opened at ₹1,22,035 per 10 g, down ₹294, and silver at ₹1,45,137 per kg, down ₹301, with Comex gold near $3,550 an ounce. Business Standard reports traders price a 96.4% chance of a December Fed hike, with US PCE data due later on Wednesday.

items.title: Gold ticks lower ahead of US inflation data
items.summary: Spot gold edged 0.3% lower to $3,544.54 an ounce after falling more than 2% in the previous session, as hawkish signals from the US Federal Reserve reinforced expectations of a December rate hike. Traders await US inflation data, the October PCE index due at 19:00 IST, for further policy clues.

items.title: Gold price tracker, Nov 25: MCX gold and silver prices fall up to 1% amid weak global cues; what's in focus next?
items.summary: MCX December gold fell ₹915, or 0.74%, to a morning low of ₹1,21,414 per 10 g, while silver slid ₹1,518 per kg to ₹1,43,920, as traders awaited US PCE inflation data. Upstox reports the 10-year US Treasury yield held near 4.9% as hawkish Fed commentary kept December hike bets firm.

items.title: Gold Crashes ₹4,250, Silver ₹9,600 in Two Days as Fed Hike Fears Wipe Out Monday's Rally
items.summary: MCX gold fell to ₹1,21,750 per 10 g and silver to ₹1,44,598 per kg, down ₹4,250 and ₹9,600 respectively over two sessions, wiping out Monday's rebound. Gujarat Samachar reports Comex gold near $3,546.70 as markets fully priced a December Fed hike ahead of Wednesday's US PCE print.

items.title: Gold and Silver Slide to Key Support as Rate Hike Fears Build
items.summary: Gold futures gave up $79.30, or 2.18%, reversing the previous session's 2.70% rally, while silver slid after breaking below $50, Kitco reports. Gold futures now test support near $3,500 and silver near $40, with traders pricing a 96.4% chance of a December Fed hike ahead of Wednesday's PCE release.

items.title: Gold & Silver Rates: MCX gold slumps by Rs 3,671, silver crashes 6% amid growing Fed hike bets
items.summary: MCX December gold fell as much as Rs 3,671, or 2.9%, to Rs 1,22,325 in the evening session and was down 2.8% at Rs 1,22,505 late in the day; December silver slid as much as Rs 9,253, or 6%, to Rs 1,44,964. Zee Business links the slide to growing bets on further Fed rate hikes and a firm dollar.

items.title: Silver Prices Fall as Hawkish Fed Signals Build Ahead of U.S. PCE Inflation Data
items.summary: Silver settled 5.69% lower at ₹1,45,438 per kg, down ₹8,779, as hawkish Fed signals built ahead of US PCE inflation data. Kedia Advisory cites a 93.5% chance of a December hike; Metals Focus forecasts global silver demand falling 5% to 1.08 billion ounces in 2026.

items.title: Gold struggles near its weekly low as Fed bets and geopolitics underpin USD ahead of US PCE
items.summary: Gold held near its weekly low as a firm dollar and bets on further Fed tightening into early 2027 capped the metal ahead of US PCE data and the second estimate of third-quarter GDP. FXStreet's Haresh Menghani writes that bearish traders are watching a break below the $3,500 level.

items.title: Gold Falls Below $3,700, Triggering Stop-Losses; BCA Ends Four-Year Bullish Bet, Sees Dollar Heading to 105
items.summary: BCA Research ended its four-year bullish gold call, downgrading the metal to neutral after a position held since November 2022 returned 113%, and sees the dollar index potentially rising to 105. BigGo Finance reports gold hovered near $3,550 an ounce in Wednesday Asian trade after closing more than 2% lower on Tuesday.

items.title: Gold rate today under pressure after dead-cat bounce from 14-month low; ₹1 lakh or ₹1.5 lakh? 3 dates to remember
items.summary: Gold slipped below ₹1,22,000 per 10 g again after Monday's dead-cat bounce, opening at ₹1,21,900 and touching ₹1,21,414, Mint reports. Experts cite expectations of a firm US inflation print, a hawkish Fed and a stronger rupee; Mint puts support at ₹1,21,700–₹1,21,000 and $3,500 an ounce.

items.title: Silver (XAG/USD) Price Forecast: Deepening Selloff Puts Major Support to the Test
items.summary: Silver fell to a low of $40.73 in Tuesday's session, failing to hold the prior low of $40.77, as sellers stayed in control since the $53.73 swing high two weeks ago, FXEmpire reports. The metal now tests a major support zone anchored by the July 2025 high of $39.53 and the 200-week moving average near $39.90, with daily RSI at its lowest since February 2023.

items.title: Silver price crash: Rates today in India down ₹1 lakh in 3 months! Recovery or more fall ahead for MCX silver futures?
items.summary: Silver in India is down about ₹1 lakh per kg in three months from its August high of around ₹2.5 lakh, with MCX silver closing Monday at ₹1,54,205 per kg after a ₹6,392 rebound. Market experts attribute the slide to elevated US bond yields, a strong dollar, talk of a US Fed rate hike and the rupee's rise from around 98 to 92.50 per dollar; they put crucial support at ₹1,40,000 per kg.

items.title: Rupee jumps 23 paise to 92.62 against US dollar in early trade
items.summary: The rupee rose 23 paise to 92.62 against the dollar in early trade, PTI reports, helped by foreign-fund inflows, a rally in domestic equities and Brent crude down 1.3%. The currency has gained over 1.6% in five sessions since 94.19 on 13 November, though a strong dollar capped further gains.

items.title: Pledged gold worth less as prices crash 30% from peak; gold loan NPAs nearly double, RBI cautions NBFCs
items.summary: Gold loan NPAs nearly doubled in six months, the ratio rising to 0.3% at the end of August from 0.16% in March, TransUnion CIBIL data cited in the report shows. With gold down nearly 30% from its peak near Rs 1.80 lakh, pledged gold is worth less and loan-to-value ratios are under pressure. The RBI has asked NBFCs to tighten scrutiny of gold-loan books and warned against rapid expansion.

items.title: Gold Sinks with AI, Silver Extends Worst Drop Since Lehmans as 'Fed Mistake' Looms
items.summary: Gold fell back to $3,560 an ounce, giving back $125 of Monday's $150 rebound, while silver dropped to $40.76, a new 14-month low and its steepest 13-week fall since the Lehman crash of 2008. BullionVault cites rising Fed hike expectations, with traders putting a 97% chance on a December rise, and quotes Bill Ackman calling a December hike a 'mistake'.

items.title: Gold Extends Losses on US Tariff-Hike Push, Fed Tightening Fears; $3,500 Support in Focus
items.summary: Gold extended its decline as the US push for higher tariffs on major economies and the prospect of further Fed tightening weighed on sentiment, with spot gold at $3,544.19 an ounce. Pepperstone strategist Dilyin Wu said holding the $3,500 level could lay the groundwork for stability, while a break below it could open the door to further declines.

items.title: Bullion tumbles again: Gold slips 0.7%, silver nearly 3% down; Three US triggers to watch
items.summary: MCX December gold futures opened 0.7% lower at Rs 1,25,112 per 10 g in the evening session and silver fell 2.35% to Rs 1,50,591 per kg, giving back part of Monday's sharp rebound. Spot gold held just above $3,630 an ounce while silver slipped to about $43, with traders awaiting US PCE inflation ahead of the Fed's December meeting.

items.title: Silver and Copper Retest Lows as Oil Nears Its Turn
items.summary: Silver and copper retested recent lows as the broad metals sell-off extended into the US session, while oil approached a turning point, Investing.com's analysis notes. The piece comes as spot silver tests the $40.50–$41.00 support zone and copper extends its slide alongside precious metals.

items.title: Silver miners struggle to close persistent supply gap
items.summary: Silver mine output is set to stay flat in 2026 despite a sixth straight annual deficit, with demand forecast to exceed supply by 35 million oz, Metals Focus estimates. Primary mines supply just 26.1% of output, the rest a byproduct of other metals mines, so higher prices alone are not lifting production. Weaker solar demand could tip the market into surplus in 2027, Deutsche Bank notes.

items.title: Gold's selloff is sowing the seeds of its next rally – Theo's Iggy Ioppe
items.summary: Theo Network's Iggy Ioppe says momentum sellers dominate as hawkish Fed expectations lift real yields and the dollar, but lower prices should eventually draw in self-correcting buyers: central banks on fixed budgets can buy more gold, and price-sensitive jewellery demand in China and India should revive. He questions how long real yields near 2.9% can stay elevated given the US fiscal position.

items.title: RBI sets SGB 2021-22 Series I premature redemption price at ₹12,612
items.summary: The RBI has fixed the premature redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series I at ₹12,612 per unit for the November 25 redemption, based on the average IBJA 999-purity gold close over November 19, 20 and 23. Holders who applied in the window that closed November 16 can exit at that price, a gain of up to 167% over the ₹4,727 online issue price.

items.title: Gold and Silver Prices Fluctuate Amid Wedding Season
items.summary: December MCX gold traded near ₹1,21,800 per 10 g and silver near ₹1,44,761 per kg as wedding-season demand met pressure from Fed hike bets. Udaipur Kiran notes traders price an over 96% chance of a December hike and await US PCE data, with support cited at $3,400 an ounce.

items.title: Salem Anklet manufacturers see a silver lining as metal price dips Rs 2L/ kg in 10 months
items.summary: Salem's silver anklet makers say orders have recovered to nearly half of normal levels after more than a year of sluggish business, as silver fell to about Rs 175 a gram in the city from Rs 195 a week ago, the article reports. Workshops that ran about two days a week now work nearly six days a week ahead of Pongal.
